note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on environment strategy and Salesforce sandbox types (Developer, Developer Pro, Partial Copy, Full) plus scratch orgs and deployment pipelines. Checked against multiple current Salesforce-community sources this session; exact storage limits, refresh intervals, and edition eligibility varied between sources and have changed over time, so this lesson deliberately avoids stating a specific fixed number for any of them and instructs students to confirm current limits on Salesforce's own sandbox documentation for their edition. No screenshot used per this course's conceptual-lessons policy.
